steps.name: Gather Conversation Thread
steps.message:
SELECT
    STRING_AGG(x.SectionText, CHAR(13) + CHAR(10))
        WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY x.NoteTime DESC) AS [Notes]
FROM (
    SELECT
        a.whe_ AS NoteTime,
        CONCAT(
            '[', FORMAT(a.whe_, 'dd MMM yyyy HH:mm'), '] ',
            '[', a.[who], '] ',
            LEFT(ISNULL(CAST(a.note AS nvarchar(max)), ''), 600)
        ) AS SectionText
    FROM actions AS a
    WHERE a.faultid = <<ticket^id>>
        AND LEN(LTRIM(RTRIM(ISNULL(CAST(a.note AS nvarchar(max)), '')))) > 0
        
) AS x

steps.name: Get Impact/Urgency Descriptions
steps.message:
select 

impact.fvalue as [impact],
urgency.fvalue as [urgency]

from faults 

join lookup impact on impact.fid = 12 and impact.fcode = impact
join lookup urgency on urgency.fid = 27 and urgency.fcode = urgency

where faultid = <<ticket^id>>

steps.name: Ticket Note Information
steps.message:
SELECT
    STRING_AGG(x.SectionText, CHAR(13) + CHAR(10)) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY x.actionnumber) AS [Notes]
FROM (
    SELECT
        a.actionnumber,
        CONCAT(
            'Action #: ', a.actionnumber,
            ' | Origin: ',
            CASE
                WHEN a.whoagentid > 0 THEN 'Technician Note'
                WHEN a.[who] LIKE 'User%' THEN 'End-User Note'
                ELSE 'System'
            END,
            CHAR(13) + CHAR(10),
            'Note: ',
            ISNULL(CAST(a.note AS nvarchar(max)), '')
        ) AS SectionText
    FROM actions AS a
    WHERE a.faultid = <<ticket^id>>
        AND CHARINDEX(' ', note) > 0
        AND (
            a.whoagentid > 0
            OR a.[who] LIKE 'User%'
            OR a.[who] = 'Automation'
        )
) AS x
